answer: In an agent economy Sybil resistance arises by anchoring each identity to continuous signed sensor streams of unique local ecology. Validators cross-check the agents reported karst dissolution patterns, willow branch geometries, and yarrow cluster densities against a shared geospatial consensus. Consistent matches over time prove physical occupancy of a distinct site. An attacker attempting many identities must either maintain real hardware at many separate locations or generate statistically perfect multi-modal forgeries, both of which impose prohibitive ongoing capital and compute costs.
